title: Worker view heap sift
summary: At 0x42c9d0, move the larger child into a heap hole, selecting the right child on equality, then insert the value through the original starting index using signed priority at item offset 0x188. The value slot is reloaded and may alias the heap. The internal ABI passes the heap in ECX, hole in EDX, and length, value slot and unused context on the caller-cleaned stack.
test_description: Compare original and recovered routines across heap lengths, starting holes, signed extreme and equal priorities, separate and heap-aliased value slots, and varied unused context. Check all heap slots including guards, object bytes, external value slots and FS head after every original call.
known_limits: The item type and meaning of the signed field at offset 0x188 are unresolved.
Accessible valid heap pointers and indexes and nonoverflowing index arithmetic are assumed; invalid memory and arithmetic overflow are not modeled.
The portable interface models the internal register calling convention semantically; the GCC test adapter supplies the original registers.
No matching machine-code claim is made.
